summary: The PR addresses the issue of query strings being dropped in redirects by modifying the catch_all_view method. The provided reproduction script and URL configuration seem appropriate for testing the fix.

issues.description: The new reproduction script uses a lambda function in the URL configuration, which might not be idiomatic for a full test case. It could be improved by using a proper view function.
The reproduction script could be improved for readability and maintainability by adding comments and possibly structuring the test logic better.
